name: MITF-M-driven melanocyte pigmentation responsive to light
rationale: Members cover melanin synthesis, pigment granule placement and MITF-M target programmes in melanocytes; unlike confusables (which add MITF-M cell-cycle/DNA-repair targets) the theme carries melanin biosynthesis and UV-A/blue-light responses.

name: Epithelial salt and water homeostasis via chloride transport
rationale: Members concern Na/K/Cl and water balance and osmotic responses through cation-chloride cotransporters and channels; distinct from confusables (K2P channels, Na/H exchangers, P-type ATPases) by chloride secretion/transepithelial chloride and paracellular transport.

core: ER entry and exit of membrane proteins
name: Anterograde ER entry and exit of membrane proteins
rationale: Members span SRP/tail-anchored/multi-pass insertion into the ER membrane and COPII cargo export to Golgi; confusables add retrograde COPI traffic, ERAD or glycosylation, which this forward-direction theme lacks.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release and reuptake
rationale: Members regulate ryanodine-receptor release, SERCA-type import and cytosolic Ca2+ clearance (NCX, caffeine response); confusables lack the SR reuptake/ATPase regulation or the NCX/caffeine arm.

name: Transcriptional control of erythroid differentiation
rationale: Members describe erythroid commitment and terminal maturation with their transcriptional drivers; confusables shift to stem-cell homeostasis or megakaryocyte/platelet development.

name: Urea cycle citrulline synthesis via ornithine transcarbamylase
rationale: All members concern the citrulline/arginine-forming step of the urea cycle; OTC deficiency variants distinguish it from confusables centred on other urea-cycle enzyme defects or ornithine metabolism.

name: Antimicrobial killing of Gram-positive bacteria and fungi
rationale: Members are effector defenses that kill or starve microbes (cytolysis, metal sequestration, antifungal responses); confusables emphasise Gram-negative killing, respiratory burst or neutrophil degranulation.

name: Dietary hexose assimilation into glycogen stores
rationale: Members cover carbohydrate digestion, hexose transport and glycogen synthesis/breakdown with their deficiencies; confusables lean to glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, galactose catabolism or urate transport.

name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signaling in tumor suppression
rationale: Members span TGF-beta/BMP/activin receptor-SMAD signaling and its regulators; cancer receptor/SMAD mutants and RUNX3 tumour-suppressor targets distinguish it from confusables (ligand sequestration, NODAL, BMP morphogen modules).

core: T and B cell receptor signaling
name: T and B cell receptor signaling tuned by co-receptors
rationale: Members are antigen-receptor proximal signaling modulated by CD28, CTLA4, BTLA, CD22 and PECAM1; confusables are T-cell-only activation/differentiation sets lacking the BCR and co-inhibitory arm.

name: Plasma membrane solute carriers for amino acids and peptides
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated uptake of amino acids, peptides, urate and glucose with their transport disorders; neutral amino acid and oligopeptide carriers set it apart from organic-cation, cationic amino acid and hexose confusables.

name: Vascular growth and remodeling with smooth muscle phenotypic switching
rationale: Members cover VEGF/Tie-driven angiogenesis and vascular wall cell behaviour; vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching distinguishes it from the endothelial-only and leukocyte-adhesion confusables.

name: Amino acid metabolism with tyrosine catabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid synthesis/catabolism (proline, glycine, glyoxylate); tyrosine/phenylalanine catabolism distinguishes it from organic-acid and threonine confusables, proline/glycine from the phenylketonuria one.

name: Osteoblast differentiation from mesenchymal progenitors under Wnt control
rationale: Members regulate mesenchymal progenitor commitment and osteoblast proliferation/differentiation via RUNX2, BMP and Wnt; Wnt antagonism and mechanical-load signaling set it apart from chondrocyte, osteoclast and collagen confusables.

name: B cell responses through antigen receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover B cell development, proliferation, homeostasis and germinal centre regulation; the BCR signaling cascade distinguishes it from confusables built on B cell surface signatures or T cell differentiation.

name: MECP2 neuronal gene repression via HDAC corepressors
rationale: Members are MECP2 regulation, its Rett-associated loss-of-function and the sensory phenotypes it controls; HDAC/NCoR corepressor engagement distinguishes it from confusables centred on motor and vocal behaviours.

name: RNA polymerase II transcription regulation with R-loop resolution
rationale: Members tune Pol II initiation, elongation and termination and chromatin access; R-loop processing and termination control separate it from elongation-complex, MYC-target and Pol I/III confusables.

name: Ryanodine-gated calcium release in cardiac excitation-contraction coupling
rationale: Members regulate SR Ca2+ release, NCX extrusion and cardiac contraction, relaxation and rate; confusables add SERCA reuptake or positive inotropic control and lack the negative regulation of cardiac contraction.

name: p53 transcriptional induction of BH3-only mitochondrial apoptosis
rationale: Members are TP53-driven transcription of death genes and PUMA/NOXA-mediated cytochrome c release; confusables lack either the TP53 transcription arm (BAX/BAK) or the BH3-only arm.

name: Ovarian cycle from follicle growth to luteolysis
rationale: Members trace follicle growth, oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteinization and luteolysis; confusables centre on gonadotropin (FSH/LH) responses rather than the luteal phase.

name: Neutral and acidic amino acid transport across plasma membrane
rationale: Members are amino acid carriers and their disorders (Hartnup, SLC1A1, SLC6A14); confusables carry imino acid/glycine (SLC6A20, SLC36A2) or peptide transport instead.

name: Centrosomal microtubule organization for spindle positioning
rationale: Members cover MTOC nucleation/anchoring, centrosome placement and astral microtubules; spindle orientation and asymmetric division distinguish it from cytokinesis and centriole-duplication confusables.

name: Plasma membrane protein delivery via endocytic recycling
rationale: Members concern endosome-to-plasma-membrane recycling and constitutive secretion; confusables are dominated by Golgi-endosome-lysosome and retrograde traffic.

name: Cardiomyocyte growth and adaptation with enhanced contractility
rationale: Members regulate cardiac muscle proliferation, hypertrophy, regeneration and survival; positive regulation of contraction and heart rate distinguishes it from the calcineurin-hypertrophy confusable, cardiac identity from the smooth-muscle ones.

name: Golgi ribbon remodeling with membrane tubulation
rationale: Members cover Golgi positioning, disassembly/reassembly and ribbon formation; membrane tubulation and ribbon dynamics distinguish it from COPI-traffic and secretory confusables.

name: DNA base damage repair including direct alkylation reversal
rationale: Members are glycosylase-initiated base excision repair and its defects plus ALKBH/MGMT reversal; confusables add mismatch or crosslink repair and lack direct alkylation reversal.

name: Rho and CDC42 GTPase cycles driving formin activation
rationale: Members are RHOA/B/C/D/G/J and CDC42 GTPase cycles; formin activation and the RHOA/B/C cycles separate it from RAC-, ROCK/PAK- and RND-centred confusables.

name: Hepatic bilirubin clearance after heme degradation
rationale: Members trace heme catabolism, UGT1A conjugation, SLCO uptake and ABCC2 export with hyperbilirubinemias; confusables are generic drug ADME sets lacking heme/bilirubin.

qualifier: from defective proline and glycine transport
name: Iminoglycinuria from defective proline and glycine transport
rationale: All three members are SLC36A2/SLC6A20 defects causing iminoglycinuria/hyperglycinuria, absent from every confusable.

name: Motor coordination and learning via cerebellar-striatal circuits
rationale: Members cover locomotion, righting, proprioception and motor learning with cerebellar layer and striatum development; confusables add vocal/auditory behaviours or glial cerebellar development.
